model.name: Method enrichment (full signature + docs) + Method-vs-Function + Uml/ts projections
model.description: ENRICH the Method ScenarioUnit with a FULL SIGNATURE: visibility (public/private/protected), name(parameters[]), returnType, and documentation (oosh-style). Projections: UmlMethod/UmlFunction + ts-method-code (typed extensions of the enriched Method/Function).
